title: opus 5.5 makes demented sea shanty pixel cutscene for my game + cute cat music vid
author: AlgaeNo3373
selftext:
I recently been messing with whisperx anyways experimenting with voice overs, subtitling, kinetic typography and other stuff for my game's tutorials, cut scenes and in-game dialogue etc. Figured I'd throw opus 5.5 into the mix. It really is quite good at directing scenes! Having whisperx timings helped it with overal choreography too. 

This scene was 2 shots/attempts, based on Claude's current understanding of the game/concept art/etc. The game's about poking a model's neurons and the song is a shanty for a particular neuron that activates frequently for "pairs". There is a kind of "latent sea" that we float on, so I'd already imagined this all out in my head lol. Making the cut scene was building on a lot of prior ideation. I'm just experimenting tbh, seeing what's possible. Maybe something like this can be a cutscene if I polished it further. Could also make some bad-ass tutorial cutscenes this way I imagine.  

[Also tried making a music video - unrelated to game just an homage to my ginger cat <3](https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1woscmx/little_test_run_of_opus_55_at_a_music_video/)

comments.author: krazyjakee
comments.body: Nice but AI is not good at writing lyrics. Take your time with them before handing to suno. Btw you using suno V6? It removes some of the tinnitus sound from the vocals.

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body:
I've not tried Suno's lyric writing thing I generally either ask GPT to try a flow or write my own, this song's lyrics in particular are built out of in-game strings from Melville's Moby Dick that light up Neuron 541. Hard to explain, lol, but the lyrics were kind of a limited choice of pairs that already exist in-game, hence being very strange/repetetive! 

And yup this is a v6 track. I find it is crisper yeah, but a bit more "same-y" in terms of vocals, but I've not played with it much wrt voices.
